name: Data Refinery
short_description: A self-repairing data pipeline workbench: contracts, drift repair with evidence, quarantine with reasons, and proof that every input row is accounted for.
capabilities: CSV, JSON and bounded XLSX intake with immutable source manifests
Schema profiling, contract validation and schema-drift detection
Repair proposals with evidence and confidence; only unambiguous repairs auto-applied
Row-level quarantine with reason codes; exact and conflicting duplicate handling
Row reconciliation identity, period restatements for late arrivals, lineage graph
Deterministic replay; GitHub-native run ledger, outcome loop and memory curation
In-browser CSV preview against the contract, never persisted
data_limitations: All batches are synthetic orders with documented, injected defects
One contract and one fixed, synthetic FX table
Durable runs process committed fixtures only; no uploads
The site shows a snapshot of the state branch, not live data
